derivation: Under zero basal_unpaid, delta M = -tau*M + g*U.
delta E = eta*U - b*M - nonnegative paid movement/memory/death-E/spill.
For bounded M, E>=0 bounds V below. Positive b-eta*tau/g rules out an infinite starvation-free trajectory with positive long-run mean M.
In any positive periodic mass cycle, maintenance alone costs b*g/tau=1.32 per U, exceeding eta=0.7 per U, before movement and memory.
interpretation: Prediction or increased input alone cannot remove this fixed growth/maintenance mismatch in the pilot model. A continuing-adaptation task must distinguish learning failure from physiological feasibility.
limits: Only this reduced-density model; not the old Lenia model or a universal biological claim.
